messages:
riley.mgr: Quick: promoted an IC who converted from contractor to FTE on 2025-12-05. Manager wants promo effective 2025-12-01 and pro-rated equity as if conversion was 12/01. Is that allowed?

pat.comp: Equity can't be legally backdated before conversion. We can do a pro-rated supplemental grant or a cash equivalent. For base we can request retro to 12/01 but payroll rules apply.

sam.payroll: Retro pay policy: <=60 days = normal payroll adj if before cutoff; >60 days = off-cycle with finance/legal. 12/01 -> today is within 60 days? (depends on today). If within 60d, include exact effective date, GL code, and headcount ID.

anya.hr: For exceptions submit the promo-exception form with: manager rationale, impact evidence (3 bullets), proposed remediation (cash or extra grant), approvers list. Attach any slack/email showing manager told the candidate promo would align with conversion.

riley.mgr: Manager has a DM thread promising alignment. Will attach. If we choose supplemental grant, any preferred vesting pattern?

pat.comp: Supplemental grant can be pro-rated with a single cliff or accelerated schedule to mirror the intended start; comp will propose a vesting schedule matching equity policy. Include suggested grant % value to speed review.

hr-bot: Reminder: tag @pat.comp and @sam.payroll in the approvers, set field 'exception_reason', and attach manager comms. Internal label only.

riley.mgr: Thanks — I'll submit with evidence and propose a one-off RSU equal to one month's target value. Will ping when done.
